assessments.reasoning: IEC publication 69675 identifies ISO/IEC 8824-1:2021, edition 6, dated 2021-06-30. Its public title and first abstract sentence expressly designate ASN.1 as the notation for data types, their values, and type constraints.

challenge.method: Compared the abstract with the issuer’s separate X.680 and X.690 publication pages, the abstract’s encoding boundary and the pinned ASN.1 source module.
challenge.results: The authorities identify ASN.1 basic notation and address encoding in separate documents. The classifier sample describes declarations, members and constraints. It independently helps identify the referent without establishing clause-level rules.

limitations: The exact claim attributes the public IEC abstract. Clause-level X.680 verification and claims about compatibility across editions remain open. Active is the registry lifecycle state.
